mission_question: Which publicly evidenced SPIDER-adjacent mechanism most directly addresses the current Graph weakness in robust procedure addressing or the product-level need to reduce repeated exploration?

actors.name: SGDR (State-Grounded Dynamic Retrieval)
actors.paper: Online Skill Learning for Web Agents via State-Grounded Dynamic Retrieval, arXiv:2606.04391, submitted 2026-06-03, authors Jiaxi Li, Ke Deng, Yun Wang, Jingyuan Huang, Yucheng Shi, Qiaoyu Tan, Jin Lu, Ninghao Liu
actors.problem_attacked: Task-level one-shot skill retrieval (retrieve at task start from instruction text only) mismatches evolving webpage states; skills go unused or misused mid-task.
actors.retained_object: Skill = dual text-code pair: natural-language description (retrieval key) + executable parameterized code (Playwright-level primitives); metadata: website, src_task_id, window {l,t}, usage_count, near_dup_of lineage. JSONL store.
actors.induction: Sliding-window extraction over evaluator-judged successful trajectories, window lengths L in {2,3,4,5}; LLM synthesis to description+code; verification/rewrite prompts per window; only successful trajectories induce.
actors.retrieval: At EVERY execution step: score_t(s_k) = alpha*cos(emb(task_goal), emb(desc_k)) + (1-alpha)*cos(emb(state_summary_t), emb(desc_k)); top-M pool max(3k,20); greedy MMR rerank mmr_lambda=0.7. Paper alpha=0.5; code default alpha=0.4 (recorded discrepancy).
actors.state_grounding: LLM StateSummarizer: accessibility tree + URL + title -> 1-2 sentence operational summary naming page kind and ENABLED action verbs in skill-description vocabulary; SHA256-content-hash cache; URL/title stub fallback on LLM failure. Verified in sgdr/retrieval/state_summarizer.py.
actors.execution: Retrieved skills injected as signature+docstring; agent may call a skill as ONE action or fall back to primitive actions; no forced execution of weak matches.
actors.verification_or_success_oracle: LLM-as-a-judge trajectory evaluation gates induction (only judged-successful trajectories produce skills).
actors.invalidation_or_freshness: usage_count tracked; near-dup lineage recorded; library archived at start of new run for same model+website. No live-site staleness/decay mechanism.
actors.fallback_on_miss: Agent proceeds with primitive actions when no retrieved skill fits; retrieval failure degrades to baseline agent rather than breaking execution.
actors.transfer_claim: WebArena five domains, two backbones (GPT-4.1 avg success 37.5%, Qwen3-4B 24.3%), reported consistent improvement over AWM / ASI / CER baselines (relative gains ~10%+). Same-site reuse setting; not a cross-domain transfer paper.
actors.evaluation_design: Online setting on WebArena (wiki removed); retained baseline runners for AWM, ASI (Agent Skill Induction), CER (Contextual Experience Replay) ship inside the repo.
actors.known_limits: Authors state WebArena covers limited domains/action sets; state summarizer costs 1 extra LLM call per novel state (cached); embedding model quality is an unstated dependency.
actors.license_ip: Code CC BY-SA 4.0 (copyleft, share-alike): clean-room reimplementation required; do not copy source into SPIDER. Paper arXiv under arXiv non-exclusive license.

actors.name: SkillMigrator / Beyond Domains
actors.paper: Beyond Domains: Reusing Web Skills via Transferable Interaction Patterns, arXiv:2606.17645, submitted 2026-06-16, UMich + Alibaba + Purdue + McMaster + UPenn
actors.retained_object: TIP (Transferable Interaction Pattern) = induced skill + structural sketch (tree skeleton tau) of the accessibility snapshot at induction time + intent + operation template + slot schema Phi.
actors.retrieval: Single global library; retrieve by LAYOUT similarity between current snapshot sketch and stored sketches, combined with text signals; then ground abstract slot constraints to live element references before replay.
actors.fallback_on_miss: Explicit fallback to primitive LLM control when no reliable layout match.
actors.measured_effect: 8-10% reduction in average LLM-action count on successful trajectories across WebArena and Mind2Web AT MATCHED SUCCESS RATE vs SOTA programmatic-skill agents (ASI, SkillWeaver, PolySkill compared).
actors.key_insight: Instruction-similarity retrieval fails cross-domain because paraphrases can need different DOM control flow; layout structure is the more robust addressing key beyond same-site and same-domain settings.
actors.license_ip: arXiv paper only; no code found; reproduce only from paper description if attempted.

actors.name: Unbrowse
actors.code: https://github.com/unbrowse-ai/unbrowse (public mirror; MIT license per marketplace listings)
actors.paper_claim: Internal APIs Are All You Need, arXiv:2604.00694 (vendor-authored benchmark paper)
actors.mechanism: Capture HAR/network traffic during browser sessions; reverse-engineer first-party API endpoints behind the UI; index them as reusable route skills with params/pagination/auth patterns; replay routes directly (<200ms cached server-fetch claims) instead of re-driving a browser; honest fallback to real browser on miss/stale routes.
actors.shared_infra_mechanisms: Shared skill registry/marketplace: publish sanitized route metadata so other agents skip rediscovery; scoring/versioning; contributor wallet payouts for contributed routes; route-graph edge publication endpoint (/v1/graph/edges).
actors.headline_numbers: 3.6x mean / 5.4x median warmed-cache speedup over Playwright across 94 live domains; <200ms cached hit; ~20-80s first discovery. TIER: OFFICIAL_CLAIM (vendor-run benchmark; not independently reproduced here).
actors.relevance_to_spider: This is the closest public implementation of SPIDER's browser-to-direct-API escalation + shared route registry product hypothesis, including invalidation-by-fallback design.
actors.license_ip: MIT (marketplace listing). Clean-room use straightforward; respect ToS questions around first-party API replay (flagged, unresolved here).

actors.name: WebNavigator
actors.paper: WebNavigator: Global Web Navigation via Interaction Graph Retrieval, arXiv:2603.20366 (March 2026), Nanjing group; supported by Fellou AI Browser
actors.code: https://github.com/fate-ubw/webNavigator (MIT); interaction graphs + precomputed embeddings for 5 WebArena domains released on HuggingFace (Jimzhang324/webNavigator)
actors.mechanism: Offline zero-token-cost heuristic exploration builds Interaction Graphs; online Retrieve-Reason-Teleport workflow does deterministic retrieval/pathfinding instead of probabilistic stepwise exploration.
actors.headline_numbers: Claims 72.9% success on WebArena multi-site tasks (OFFICIAL_CLAIM/PAPER_EVIDENCE; not independently reproduced here).
actors.relevance_to_spider: Directly adjacent to TEAM GRAPH's accumulated-topology idea and to PHYSICS's graph-vs-dynamics separation: it treats navigation as graph pathfinding once topology is known.
actors.spider_lane: GRAPH (and relevant context for PHYSICS nulls)

actors.name: Agent Workflow Memory (AWM)
actors.paper: Agent Workflow Memory, arXiv:2409.07429, ICML 2025, CMU+MIT (Wang, Mao, Fried, Neubig)
actors.mechanism: Induce reusable textual workflows (description + abstracted steps) from successful trajectories, online or offline; merge recurring subroutines; inject selected workflows into prompt. +24.6% relative Mind2Web, +51.1% relative WebArena (PAPER_EVIDENCE); ICML reviews note methodology criticisms (unclear induction methodology, missing benchmarks) — treat headline deltas cautiously.
actors.limit_for_spider: Retrieval is task-level/textual; SGDR shows this static strategy is weaker than state-grounded stepwise retrieval.

actors.name: SkillWeaver
actors.paper: SkillWeaver: Web Agents can Self-Improve by Discovering and Honing Skills, arXiv:2504.07079, OSU NLP
actors.mechanism: Autonomous skill proposal by exploration; practice executions; reward-model-guided honing; distillation into robust Python APIs; APIs become plug-and-play tools. +31.8% relative WebArena, +39.8% relative real-world sites; strong-to-weak agent skill transfer up to +54.3% relative (PAPER_EVIDENCE). Compared against human-crafted APIs extracted from official docs — synthesized APIs approached human-API performance.
actors.provisional_verdict: WATCH (induction side; its retrieval remains semantic/task-level)

actors.name: PolySkill
actors.paper: PolySkill: Learning Generalizable Skills Through Polymorphic Abstraction, arXiv:2510.15863
actors.mechanism: Decouple skill abstract GOAL from concrete IMPLEMENTATION (polymorphism); self-exploration proposes own curriculum goals. Claims 1.7x skill reuse on seen sites, +9.4% Mind2Web, +13.9% unseen sites, >20% step reduction (PAPER_EVIDENCE).
actors.spider_lane: GRAPH (goal/implementation separation maps to fragment schema design)

actors.name: NeoCognition
actors.facts: OSU NLP spinout (Yu Su, Xiang Deng, Yu Gu; Mind2Web/SeeAct lineage), $40M seed April 2026, continual-learning 'world model for micro-worlds' positioning.
actors.evidence_tier: OFFICIAL_CLAIM only — no public mechanism details as of cycle 1.

mechanisms: Discovery/ranking driven by anonymous install telemetry from the open-source `skills` CLI (usage-based popularity signal, not editorial).
Packs: bundle public+private skills behind one install command (distribution primitive).
Trust: routine security audits surfaced at /audits plus explicit non-guarantee disclaimer; official curation tier.
Skills distributed as SKILL.md instruction packages via CLI install; installs + ratings metadata; multi-host targeting (Claude Code/Codex/Cursor/Windsurf memory-file injection patterns).
Same skill artifact mirrored across multiple registries with divergent version fields — versioning discipline in the ecosystem is weak.
Publish/score/version sanitized route metadata; global + per-domain search endpoints; feedback channel tied to diagnostics; contributor wallet payouts (paid-route spending identity).

Three-tier execution ladder: skill cache (<200ms) -> shared route graph (sub-second) -> full browser traversal (source of truth). Explicit rule: do NOT silently substitute API replay for browser steps during live traversal.
steam_like_infrastructure_findings.note: Closest existing implementation of the Steam-like shared-capability question for WEB ROUTES specifically; incentive layer (payouts) is OFFICIAL_CLAIM.
Marketplace security/threat-model literature now exists; any SPIDER shared-registry design must account for documented injection-via-skill attacks.

selection_decision.reason: Mission asks for the mechanism most directly addressing Graph's measured weakness in ROBUST PROCEDURE ADDRESSING (weak paraphrase addressing; hand-authored goal_sig only; entry-context mismatch failure mode) while also reducing repeated exploration. SGDR is (a) PAPER_EVIDENCE with exact formulas and CODE_VERIFIED core components (scoring, MMR, dedup, state summarizer verified in public source this cycle); (b) precisely the addressing upgrade SPIDER fragments need (task+state fused retrieval at every step, with explicit primitive fallback); (c) maps 1:1 onto the existing Graph store schema (fragments.goal_sig/steps, states.raw_json snapshots), making a minimal matched-baseline experiment feasible without new infrastructure; (d) ships its own strongest baselines (AWM, ASI, CER) for comparison design. Runner-up SkillMigrator (layout-conditioned TIP retrieval) targets the harder cross-domain case but has no public code, smaller measured effect (8-10% action reduction), and higher reproduction risk; it is recorded as WATCH for a later cycle once SGDR-style addressing exists as scaffolding.
